title: Health Review: Infection, Pressure and Risk

review_words.key_point_zh: 动词“感染”读 /kənˈtrækt/，名词“合同”读 /ˈkɒntrækt/，听力常靠重音区分词义；书面语中比 catch 更正式。
review_words.example: Volunteers working in crowded shelters were more likely to contract the infection than office staff.
review_words.translation_zh: 在拥挤的收容所做志愿工作的人比办公室职员更容易感染这种疾病。
review_words.note_zh: contract 后直接接疾病名称，不加 with；口语中更常说 catch。

review_words.key_point_zh: 固定搭配 be susceptible to + 名词，阅读中常与 vulnerable、prone 构成同义替换，用来指出易感人群。
review_words.example: People with weakened immune systems are particularly susceptible to food-borne infections.
review_words.translation_zh: 免疫系统较弱的人尤其容易感染食源性疾病。
review_words.note_zh: 介词固定用 to；程度可用 particularly、highly 修饰。

review_words.key_point_zh: 阅读中常被 widespread、common 同义替换；写作描述现象“日益普遍”用 increasingly prevalent，比 common 正式。
review_words.example: Short-sightedness has become increasingly prevalent among primary school children in urban areas.
review_words.translation_zh: 城市小学生中的近视问题正变得日益普遍。
review_words.note_zh: increasingly 修饰 prevalent 是写作高频组合；说明范围时常用 among 或 in。

review_words.key_point_zh: 写作高频搭配 put a strain on 描述公共资源承受的压力；听力中又常作动词指“拉伤”肌肉，一词多义易设干扰。
review_words.example: Rising numbers of elderly patients are putting a strain on community care services.
review_words.translation_zh: 老年患者人数不断增加，正给社区护理服务带来压力。
review_words.note_zh: 此处 strain 为不可数名词，常用 put/place a strain on sth 结构。

review_words.key_point_zh: 写作中替代 reduce、ease 的正式动词，常搭配 symptoms、poverty、burden；阅读中常被同义替换为 relieve。
review_words.example: Allowing staff to work from home two days a week could alleviate congestion on the roads at rush hour.
review_words.translation_zh: 允许员工每周两天居家办公，可以缓解高峰时段道路拥堵。
review_words.note_zh: alleviate 是及物动词，后面直接跟被缓解的对象，中间不加介词。

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: I've been reading that flu is far more prevalent in winter than in summer. Is it just because we all stay indoors?

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: That's a big part of it. Once the virus gets into a crowded, poorly ventilated room, people who are already run down are much more susceptible to it.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: So what actually works? I keep seeing advertisements for supplements that claim to alleviate the symptoms.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Most of them make very little difference. Sleep, fresh air and vaccination matter far more, and they also reduce the strain on hospitals in January.

dialogue.speaker: A
dialogue.text: That makes sense. My flatmate works night shifts and seems to contract something every few months.

dialogue.speaker: B
dialogue.text: Shift work really does wear down the immune system. If he can protect a regular sleep window, he'll be less likely to pick things up.

quiz.question: The government hopes to ___ the financial burden on low-income families.
quiz.explanation_zh: alleviate 表示“减轻（负担、痛苦）”，与 burden 搭配自然；contract 作动词意为“感染/收缩”，strain 意为“拉伤/使紧张”，prevail 是不及物动词“盛行”，均不合。

quiz.question: Which sentence uses the correct preposition after “susceptible”?
options: Older adults are especially susceptible to dehydration.
Older adults are especially susceptible of dehydration.
Older adults are especially susceptible for dehydration.
Older adults are especially susceptible with dehydration.
quiz.explanation_zh: be susceptible to 是固定搭配，to 后接名词或动名词；表示“易受……影响”时不能用 of、for 或 with。

quiz.question: The infection is most ___ in overcrowded housing, where it spreads quickly.
quiz.explanation_zh: prevalent 意为“普遍的”，可接 in/among 说明常见范围；susceptible 需接 to 且主语通常是人或群体；strained 与 alleviated 为分词，语义不符。
